name: SDN Standards Discovery Flow
description: Gateway standards flow (mount GET /api/v1/standards): foundation/http-route discover decides the request as an $APR (standards); hostcap/p2p-discovery standards_snapshot reads the host's newest signed $PNM per (peer, standard) through p2p.standards_snapshot (typed $PIV, capability p2p_read) and answers a $PNV beside the $APR; foundation/http-respond respond renders the $HTR ($PNV FlatBuffers by default, JSON on request). foundation/discovery-shape is retired. Typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one SDS FlatBuffers type; no JSON travels between nodes (JSON exists only as the client representation http-respond renders on request).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Peer and standards discovery served by the G.2 gateway flows (wasm; routing, format selection and ETag logic run inside the module; snapshots come from the policy-mediated p2p_read capability).

routes.summary: Standards published across known peers, with publishers
routes.description: The newest signed publication notice per (peer, standard) this node holds, as its verdicts (SDS Publication Verification): publisher, relaying peer, standard, FILE_ID / FILE_NAME / CID, publish time, signature and whether it verified, attribution and key source. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists. Conditional GET: the record's ETAG (a content tag, stable across calls while the content is unchanged) rides the etag header; If-None-Match equal to it answers 304.

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed $PNM FlatBuffer stream (default), json = bare JSON array of publication records.

200.description: One $PNV. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: $PNV (SDS PNV.fbs): The newest signed publication notice per (peer, standard) this node holds, as its verdicts (SDS Publication Verification): publisher, relaying peer, standard, FILE_ID / FILE_NAME / CID, publish time, signature and whether it verified, attribution and key source.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match equals the record's ETAG.

schema.description: $APR (SDS APR.fbs): the refusal record (STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE)
$APR (SDS APR.fbs): the refusal record (STATUS / ERROR_CODE / ERROR_MESSAGE)
